source: Freely licensed gait video for demonstrating the pipeline on outside footage (CC-BY-2.0)
note: Video the loading model was never trained on. Pose detection, the canonical frame, the density mapping, the contact solve and the geometry are honest on any footage -- they are deterministic given their input. The loading stage is extrapolating: treat its output as illustrative of the pipeline, not as a measurement of the person in the video.

stages.title: Pose detection
stages.detail: 44 of 44 sampled frames had a person detected (100%)

stages.title: Kinematic features
stages.detail: 130 features per frame, 37 usable frames. Ankle, knee and hip positions normalised by torso length.

stages.title: Predicted plantar loading
stages.detail: Peak total load at frame 1. Units are raw sensor counts, not kPa.
stages.caveat: The model was trained on one fixed camera in one room with shod feet. On any other video this is out of distribution — illustrative of the pipeline, not a measurement of this person.

stages.title: Canonical plantar frame
stages.detail: 32 predicted channels lifted onto a shared plantar grid.

stages.title: Pressure → material
stages.detail: Soften mapping: higher predicted pressure → lower lattice density.

stages.title: Contact simulation
stages.detail: Shore 70A, 14 mm. Peak 204 kPa over 70 cm². Accepted.
stages.caveat: Simulated under a Winkler foundation model with a nominal 700 N load. kPa here is a model output, not a measurement.

stages.title: Graded insole
stages.detail: 106,308 faces, watertight=True, connected=True. STL ready to slice.

attribution:
ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC BY 2.0). treadmill_walk.ogv is Additional file 1 of Yoon J, Park H-S, Damiano DL, 'A novel walking speed estimation scheme and its application to treadmill control for gait rehabilitation', Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation 9:62 (2012), doi:10.1186/1743-0003-9-62, via Wikimedia Commons.
Theora/.ogv at 720x480, 29.97 fps, 45 s. download_data.py transcodes a 10 s window to H.264 treadmill_walk.mp4, which is what the pipeline reads.
OUT OF DISTRIBUTION on purpose. The loading model was trained on a fixed room camera with participants walking toward or away from it; this is a sagittal treadmill view of a different person. The camera also crops the head, so the torso-length normalisation the pose features rely on is degraded.
